summary: the push and merge gates no longer ask for a review and QA on a new app's bootstrap, its start building commit, or a release that only moves the version
appCreator: A new app reaches its first feature without three review and QA rounds on files nobody wrote: the bootstrap, "start building" and a release that only bumps the version go through; anything written or edited by hand in them is still reviewed. The lockfile npm writes at "start building" gets one standard review instead of the deep one, unless code finds a package in it that is not from the npm registry or has no integrity hash.
